title: Beacon Plaza | Investment and Sales Offering Memorandum (Revised)
subtitle: Charlotte, NC | Office | As of 2026-09-01 (supersedes 2026-08-31 roll)

sections.heading: Executive summary
paragraphs: Source-backed analysis. Assumptions remain subject to diligence.

Revision applied per 2026-09-01 certified roll and revision notice: Suite 010 moved from pending to active and its scheduled monthly rent increased by $225; sizing rate increased by 75 bps to 7.50%; capitalization rate increased by 25 bps to 7.75%. All other underwriting rules unchanged.

Updated results: 12 suites, 66,360 SF. Physical occupancy now 10 of 12 (two vacant). Stabilized GPR updated to $1,621,500. UW EGI $1,544,625; UW NOI before reserves $1,045,022; UW NCF after reserves $1,041,422. Capitalization value at 7.75%: $13.48MM. With higher sizing rate 7.50%, the maximum loan declines to approximately $8.09MM (still LTV-constrained). Net cash out falls to about $1.464MM after fees and payoff.
No photos, market comps, sponsor information or asking price are provided or assumed.

sections.heading: What changed vs prior version
paragraphs: Suite 010 status: pending → active; monthly rent +$225 (from $11,050 to $11,275).
Certified roll date advanced from 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-01; total units and areas unchanged.
Initial sizing rate increased from 6.75% to 7.50% (75 bps); capitalization rate increased from 7.50% to 7.75% (25 bps).

Effects: GPR +$2,700 annually; EGI +$2,565; management fee +$77; NOI before reserves +$2,488; NCF +$2,488; higher cap rate reduces value by about $415k; higher sizing rate reduces DSCR-based loan sizing; binding LTV constraint declines with value, reducing maximum loan by about $250k; net cash out decreases accordingly.

sections.heading: Property overview and unit/suite mix (unchanged)
paragraphs: Unit groups per manager mapping: A = Small suite, B = Standard suite, C = Large suite. Areas per suite type remain Small 5,380 SF; Standard 5,500 SF; Large 5,710 SF.

sections.heading: Lease and occupancy analysis (revised)
paragraphs: As of 2026-09-01 certified roll: 10 active, 0 pending, 2 vacant. Suite 010 commenced and increased rent to $11,275/mo per revision notice and revised roll. Other suites unchanged.
Near-term rollover: still Suite 001 with expiration 2027-02-28; remains within 12 months from the as-of date; near-term rollover risk present.

sections.heading: Historical vs underwritten financials (revised where impacted)
paragraphs: T12 expense inputs unchanged. Underwriting still uses all-suite scheduled rent ×12 with 5% loss, and other income $350/suite/year. Only GPR and resulting EGI/NOI/NCF change; management fee and value recalculated accordingly.

sections.heading: Debt sizing and sources/uses (revised)
paragraphs: Constraints unchanged. With higher cap rate and sizing rate, the LTV cap falls to ≈$8.09MM; DSCR cap falls to ≈$9.93MM; Debt Yield cap ≈$11.57MM; LTV remains binding. Net cash out ≈$1.465MM after 1% fee, $45k costs and $6.5MM payoff.

sections.heading: Risks and missing diligence (updated)
paragraphs: Pending-in-occupancy inclusion risk: still present in manager headline logic, but no pending units on the revised roll; occupancy now 10 active, 2 vacant.
Near-term rollover risk: present (Suite 001 expiry within 12 months).
All other risk conclusions unchanged from prior version.
